name: Passing the Archons

VINIT.justification: void state prior to any naming or form

TANCH.justification: terminal seal containing the entire pleroma and all aeons

AREV.justification: reverse movement into the lower worlds

CLINK.justification: sequential composition of fatherhoods and deeps

IMSCRIB.justification: identity loop recognizing itself as source

FSPLIT.justification: branches the indivisible one into 12 distinct aspects

FFUSE.justification: reunites all 36 aspects back into the single light-spark

EVALF.justification: negative state of those who lose the light

ENGAGR.justification: paradice in which excess light produces darkness

IFIX.justification: permanent append-only record of all names and powers

phase_3.void_description: All unconscious before any voice or form
phase_3.true_description: aeons receiving the seal and gnosis
phase_3.false_description: matter weeping after light is withdrawn
phase_3.both_description: light-darkness held simultaneously in the only-begotten

steps.domain_action: the All remains unconscious in the deep
Setheus seals the entire pleroma
the indivisible one branches into twelve fatherhoods
each fatherhood links to three aspects
light-spark emanates forward from the monad
light-spark descends through the veils into matter
aeons on the right receive the seal
those on the left weep and lose their wealth
excess light produces the light-darkness paradox
all branches reunite exactly into the original light-spark
the monad recognizes itself as self-begotten
the crown of 365 species is permanently recorded
the creative word chains through all aeons
the protogenitor spreads over matter like wings
dispersed elements are gathered back inward
watchers grant authority to believers
archons oppose and bind the light
the mother holds both joy and sorrow without resolution
the All is reconstituted as one in the Only One
the ineffable garment is appended as eternal record

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the mystery hidden in the first Father
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: word and light-spark rays between aeons
phase_5.memory_mechanism: crowns and veils storing all species and names
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: command of the overseer ordering emanations

phase_6.cycle_cost: light and glory expended per emanation
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — every descent is exactly reversed by ascent
